architecture_override.candidate_semantics: A make-before-break candidate is a new transport incarnation of an existing logical LaneID 1..4. Physical transport slots are bounded to 1..5; exactly one unused slot is replacement overlap capacity during four-lane operation, never a fifth logical lane.
architecture_override.multipath: Normal desired=1; Game/weak desired=2..4. Independent lane transport state shares one Logical Tunnel identity/lease and one SessionID/PacketID race domain. First valid arrival wins; duplicate suppressed; no cross-lane HOL.
architecture_override.replacement: Generation-fenced make-before-break A -> A+B -> B; candidate failure preserves healthy old lane and last-known-good baseline; Game rotates one logical lane at a time.
architecture_override.server_path: Linux final is one shared WBD TUN + one WBD-owned host NAT.
architecture_override.tcp_like_core: FakeTCP/Reality/wolfSSL DTLS/LINK/FEC wire is frozen unless deterministic lower-layer evidence proves a defect.
